The 2016 Chevrolet Equinox LS, equipped with the Equipment Group 1LS, is an outstanding choice for those looking for a reliable and comfortable compact SUV. This model comes with a powerful ECOTEC 2.4L I-4 gasoline direct injection engine, providing 182 horsepower paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission.

One of the standout features of the Equinox LS is its mobile hotspot capability, allowing you to connect your devices to the internet on the go. This feature ensures you stay connected without consuming your personal data, making road trips more enjoyable. Additionally, the rear camera is an invaluable safety feature that enhances visibility when reversing, helping you avoid obstacles and ensuring you have an extra set of eyes when you need it most.

Safety is further enhanced with the inclusion of brake assist technology. This system detects panic braking and applies maximum power to the brakes, potentially preventing accidents before they happen. The cruise control with steering wheel-mounted controls also adds convenience, allowing you to maintain a set speed effortlessly, reducing fatigue during long drives.

The 2016 Equinox LS also boasts a user-friendly touchscreen interface, making it easy to access various features without fumbling with buttons and knobs. Comfort is paramount in this vehicle, with features like the power 2-way driver lumbar support and power height-adjustable driver seat, which allow you to customize your driving position for maximum comfort.

Under the hood, the variable valve timing technology ensures optimal performance at both low and high RPMs, contributing to better fuel efficiency and cleaner emissions. This inline 4-cylinder DOHC engine provides the perfect balance of power and economy, ensuring you get where youre going while saving on fuel costs.

Moreover, the tracker system with vehicle slowdown offers peace of mind by enabling you to monitor your vehicles location, an essential feature for added security. If your vehicle is ever stolen, this system allows law enforcement to remotely slow it down, ensuring a safe recovery.

In summary, the 2016 Chevrolet Equinox LS with the Equipment Group 1LS package is not only a stylish and versatile SUV but also a safe and connected vehicle perfect for everyday driving and adventures alike. With its impressive features and reliable performance, the Equinox is a top contender in its class.

The 2014 Nissan Rogue S is a standout compact SUV that offers a perfect blend of safety, technology, and fuel efficiency. This model features an impressive 2.5L I-4 DOHC engine generating 170 horsepower, paired with an Xtronic CVT for a smooth driving experience.

One of the key highlights of the 2014 Nissan Rogue S is its *Rear Camera*. This feature greatly enhances safety by providing a clear view of the area behind the vehicle, allowing drivers to navigate tight spaces and busy streets with confidence. With this rear camera, you gain an extra set of eyes, ensuring you can spot any obstacles or hazards that may be lurking behind you.

Equipped with a *Brake Assist* system, the Rogue S is designed to enhance your safety further. This system detects sudden braking events and automatically applies additional braking power, helping to prevent potential accidents. Whether its a sudden stop for a pedestrian or an unexpected obstacle, the Rogue S ensures you are always prepared for the unexpected.

For those long road trips, the *Cruise Control with Steering Wheel Mounted Controls* is a fantastic feature. It allows you to maintain a consistent speed without the need to keep your foot on the accelerator. This not only reduces driver fatigue but also contributes to improved fuel economy, making your journeys more enjoyable.

The *Variable Valve Timing* technology in the Rogue S optimizes engine performance across various driving conditions. This means you can enjoy a balance of power and fuel efficiency, making it a great choice for both city driving and highway cruising.

Moreover, the *Inline 4-Cylinder* engine configuration provides adequate horsepower while ensuring better fuel efficiency and lower maintenance costs. Combined with the *DOHC* system, the Rogue S delivers excellent performance, making it capable of handling diverse driving scenarios with ease.

Music lovers will appreciate the *Wireless Audio Streaming* feature, which allows you to connect your mobile device to the vehicles sound system wirelessly. This means you can enjoy your favorite playlists or podcasts without the hassle of cords, enhancing your driving experience.

Additionally, the *Ignition Immobilizer* system adds a layer of security, preventing theft by ensuring the vehicle can only be started with the correct key. This peace of mind is invaluable for owners when parking their vehicle.

In summary, the 2014 Nissan Rogue S is a versatile SUV that effectively combines safety, advanced technology, and fuel efficiency. Whether youre commuting or embarking on a weekend adventure, this compact SUV is ready to meet all your driving needs.

Condition: Sold strictly AS-IS.
